The food is a small piece of baked salmon with herbs and a few grains of rice on top. Using the plate as a ruler (a square plate about 26 cm across), the fillet measures roughly 8 × 5 cm and is about 2.5 cm thick. That works out to around 90 g. Baked salmon has roughly 200 kcal per 100 g, so this piece comes to about 180–190 kcal, plus a little oil.
